title: GCD on Blackboard
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ integers, $A_1, A_2, ..., A_N$, written on the blackboard.

You will choose one of them and replace it with an integer of your choice between $1$ and $10^9$ (inclusive), possibly the same as the integer originally written.

Find the maximum possible greatest common divisor of the $N$ integers on the blackboard after your move.

## Constraints

- All values in input are integers.
- $2 \leq N \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$

## Output

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 ... A_N
```

## Output

Print the maximum possible greatest common divisor of the $N$ integers on the blackboard after your move.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

黑板上写有 $N$ 个整数 $A_1, A_2, ..., A_N$。

你可以选择其中一个整数，将其替换为一个你选择的、介于 $1$ 和 $10^9$（含）之间的整数，也可以选择与原来写在黑板上的整数相同的整数。

求进行操作后，黑板上 $N$ 个整数的最大公约数可能达到的最大值。

## 约束条件

- 输入中的所有值均为整数。
- $2 \leq N \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$

## 输出格式

输入格式如下：

```
N
A_1 A_2 ... A_N
```

## 输出格式

输出进行操作后，黑板上 $N$ 个整数的最大公约数可能达到的最大值。

samples.note: If we replace $7$ with $4$, the greatest common divisor of the three integers on the blackboard will be $2$, which is the maximum possible value.
We can replace an integer with itself.
